gemstone.name: Citrien
gemstone.editorialText: CITRIEN · W41 — Een lichtgele tot bruinoranje variëteit van kwarts. Sporen van ijzer geven de steen zijn kleur. Natuurlijke citrien is zeldzaam; veel citrien ontstaat door het verhitten van amethist. De steen wordt gebruikt voor sieraden en gesneden ornamenten. Steen 6 van de Music-DNA-slinger.
gemstone.selectionReason: Continuation from W39 orange-red carnelian and W40 reddish-orange imperial topaz toward warm yellow quartz.

rules: tracks are the primary content truth
current Ontdek DNA rule: one track per artist; 21 tracks means 21 unique artists
uniqueArtists must be derived from tracks
Spotify success does not imply full week publication success
Saturday gift composition: retain all positive weekly discoveries, up to 21; fill remaining slots from positive reserve. W40 actual: 20 week-positive + 1 positive-reserve.
Spotify folder placement is a known technical limitation; operational delivery records this exception without claiming placement.
weekly gemstone cover must be generated and attached to the Spotify playlist before the automatic delivery is considered complete
gemstone sequence counter is continuous from 2026-W36 = stone 1 and is written numerically
gemstone editorial copy is short, factual and non-symbolic; no invented relation to Ben, taste or weekly flow
freezing snapshots the exact ordered track IDs; the curated Flow-DNA order must not change afterward
